opportunities.event: A courier drops a letter on the table; the seal is the brother's own mark.
opportunities.cue: a letter has come with your brother's seal on it

opportunities.event: The guild treasurer announces this month's pay will be late.
opportunities.cue: the guild's pay is late this month

opportunities.event: Someone has waxed and restrung the shortbow left on the rack.
opportunities.cue: someone took care of your bow while you were away

opportunities.event: The candles burn low and the hall goes quiet for a while.
A map of the Sun Ruins is pinned up, with one corridor circled in red.
opportunities.cue: the corridor your brother was last seen in is circled on the new map

opportunities.event: Two recruits start a shoving match over the last bunk.
opportunities.cue: two recruits are fighting in your hall

opportunities.event: A barmaid sets down a free round 'from an admirer'.
opportunities.cue: a free drink arrived from someone who will not say who

opportunities.event: Outside, a cart rattles past on the wet cobbles.
A mercenary laughs at the oversized chainmail hanging on its peg.
opportunities.cue: a mercenary is mocking your borrowed chainmail

opportunities.event: The city council's messenger demands the guild's roster by nightfall.
opportunities.cue: the council wants the guild roster by tonight

opportunities.event: A quiver of fresh arrows turns up, fletched with grey goose feathers.
opportunities.cue: a full quiver of good arrows has turned up

opportunities.event: A clock somewhere in the city strikes the hour.
A traveller says she saw a young man in guild colours near the ruins last week.
opportunities.cue: a traveller may have seen your brother near the ruins

opportunities.event: The roof starts leaking right over the map table.
opportunities.cue: the hall roof is leaking onto the maps

opportunities.event: A dice game in the corner turns loud and someone accuses a cheat.
opportunities.cue: there is a cheating row at the dice table

opportunities.event: The wind changes, and the smoke from the hearth drifts toward the door.
A guard captain asks for a volunteer to stand watch at the north gate.
opportunities.cue: the guard wants a volunteer for the north gate

opportunities.event: A retired adventurer toasts 'to old Ponticius, who once carried me home'.
opportunities.cue: an old friend is toasting a rescue you made years ago

opportunities.event: A pickpocket is caught with a guild badge sewn into his coat.
opportunities.cue: a thief was caught posing as a guild member

opportunities.event: A cat walks along the top of the map shelf and settles there.
Someone has left a lucky charm on Luke's pack, a little carved fox.
opportunities.cue: someone left you a carved fox charm, like the one your brother had

opportunities.event: The guild's last healer gives notice; she is leaving for the coast.
opportunities.cue: the guild is losing its last healer

opportunities.event: A rival guild's banner is seen flying over the market.
opportunities.cue: a rival guild has hung its banner in the market

opportunities.event: Somebody opens a window, then thinks better of it and shuts it.
An apprentice asks whether anyone can teach him to shoot straight.
opportunities.cue: an apprentice wants someone to teach him archery

opportunities.event: A list of volunteers for the ruins expedition is posted, and it is very short.
opportunities.cue: almost no one has volunteered for the ruins

opportunities.event: The kitchen runs out of bread and the cook blames the guild master.
opportunities.cue: the cook is blaming you for the bread running out

opportunities.event: The crowd in the hall thins as the evening goes on.
A heavy rain closes the river ferry for three days.
opportunities.cue: the ferry is closed for three days

opportunities.event: A boy delivers a sword with a note: 'Your brother left this with us.'
opportunities.cue: a sword your brother left behind has been returned

opportunities.event: The hall's old founding plaque has been chipped off the wall.
opportunities.cue: someone damaged the guild's founding plaque

opportunities.event: A kettle starts to whistle in the back room.
A drunk challenges anyone in the room to an arm-wrestle for coin.
opportunities.cue: a drunk is offering coin for an arm-wrestle

opportunities.event: A guild mapmaker admits the sewer map she sold was guesswork.
opportunities.cue: the sewer map you paid for was made up

opportunities.event: The merchant who owes the guild money walks in as if nothing happened.
opportunities.cue: the merchant who owes the guild is here

opportunities.event: Rain taps steadily at the shutters.
Someone mentions that the brother's old room is being cleared out tomorrow.
opportunities.cue: your brother's old room is being cleared tomorrow

opportunities.event: A new recruit asks the guild master if the stories about the Sun Ruins are true.
opportunities.cue: a recruit is asking about the old Sun Ruins stories

opportunities.event: A pair of stolen daggers is found under a loose floorboard.
opportunities.cue: a pair of stolen daggers turned up under the floor

opportunities.event: A lantern is moved from one table to another.
